products.name: The Shalimar Dining Table
products.tagline: Eight seats, one hundred years of dinners.
products.description: A long table in solid sheesham, its top drawn from a single seasoned plank and finished with a hand-rubbed oil that deepens with every year. The legs are pinned with traditional mortise-and-tenon joints — no screws, no shortcuts.

products.name: The Kashmir Bed Frame
products.description: Chinar-leaf carving runs along the headboard of this king bed, each motif cut by hand in our Rawalpindi workshop. The frame is seasoned deodar — cedar that smells faintly of the hills it came from.

products.name: The Margalla Wardrobe
products.description: Three bays, a full-length mirror framed in rosewood, and hanging rails mounted on seasoned hardwood bearers. Built to be inherited, not replaced.

products.name: The Faizabad Centre Table
products.description: A low table for long evenings — aproned corners, chamfered edges, and a finish you can put a cup of chai down on without thinking twice.

products.name: The Gulberg Armchair
products.tagline: A chair you negotiate for at family gatherings.
products.description: Deep-cushioned, wide-armed, and sprung with jute webbing the old way. The frame is kiln-dried hardwood; the covers are removable and re-sewable.

products.name: The Murree Bookshelf
products.description: Shelves sit on brass pin rests, so the spacing changes as your library does. The back is solid wood, not ply — it matters when you open a door fifty years from now.

products.name: The Crescent Writing Desk
products.tagline: Two drawers that close with one hand.
products.description: A modest desk with dovetailed drawers that ride on waxed runners, cut for a laptop and a lamp and nothing you don't need.
